purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for HSR Level 2 (15.5 m) — Two-Track Adjacent Crossover Right.
name: HSR Level 2 (15.5 m) — Two-Track Adjacent Crossover Right
description: Switches between two adjacent two-track lines, with no empty tile between them. Both through lines are retained. Choose a handed crossover or a scissors for transfers in both hands.

provenance.geometry: NAM Team HSR/GHSR texture and deck profiles; SCP procedural junctions and diagonal curves. Height adapters preserve the eight audited native ramp tile models.
provenance.construction: SCP right-hand-running fixed-piece rules and explicit directed Monorail paths; native ramp coordinates retained.

design_review.summary: Closely spaced pillars need a support-consolidation review.
reasons: Separate 1.3 m-square pillar foundations have centres less than 2.6 m apart near shared rail geometry. The foundations do not overlap, but the close pair should be reviewed and consolidated to address the reported duplicate-pillar appearance. The 2.6 m review cutoff is an authoring convention, not a structural or game collision threshold.
